Loc.Name: Bramblelord Cudgel
Loc.Description: A knotted bough still green at the core; its thorns drink from every hand that dares to strike its bearer.

Items.DesignNote: Set entry weapon: baseline BLUNT kit with a starter THRN 2 so the retaliation loop begins at COMMON. C-STAT-11 (THRN is flat, unreduced, fires even on BLOCKED melee hits, ranged-immune); C-DEF-04 (BLOCKED hits still trigger thorns). BLUNT template copied from ClassAbilityTemplates, Rolls 4 as live-observed.

Loc.Name: Bramblelord Cuirass
Loc.Description: Living briars laced through boiled leather. The vines know their lord, and answer every wound dealt to him in kind.

Items.DesignNote: Core body piece of the retaliation tank: THRN 4 sits at live ARMOR_BODY|UNCOMMON curve (observed 4-5), DEF pairs per C-DEF-01 (flat subtraction, floor 0) so blocked hits still feed C-STAT-11 thorns via C-DEF-04. Entangle immunity keeps the melee-facing tank free to hold the line (C-STATUS-23: ENTANGLE blocks melee/move/flee).

Loc.Name: Bramblelord Crown of Wardens
Loc.Description: A wreath of iron-hard thorns. Those who shelter in its shadow cannot be touched; those who reach past it bleed.

Items.DesignNote: Backline protector: SKILL_GUARD projects the tile aura behind the wearer, making guarded tiles untargetable by enemies (C-STATUS-11) - this funnels melee into the thorn tank, where C-STAT-11 pays it back. DEF/RES per C-DEF-01 flat mitigation; THRN 2 within live head-slot magnitudes (ARMOR_HEAD|UNCOMMON THRN 1-5, ARTIFACT 3).

Loc.Name: Heart of the Briarwood
Loc.Description: A fist-sized knot of thorned root that beats, slowly. Wounds taken by its keeper close over by morning; wounds it gives do not.

Items.DesignNote: Sustain piece: THRN 3 and HRG 3 both at live ARMOR_TRINKET|RARE curve (THRN 3-5, HRG 3-5). C-STAT-11 makes the trinket's THRN stack additively with the rest of the set (thorns read the target's total THRN stat); C-STAT-10 (HRG = flat out-of-combat end-of-turn regen) refills the HP the tank trades for retaliation.

Loc.Name: Aegis of the Bramblelord
Loc.Description: The first bramble ever to refuse an axe, grown flat and patient. Every blow it turns aside is repaid with interest in thorns.

Items.DesignNote: Set ARTIFACT and keystone: SKILL_STEADFAST requires an equipped shield and scales on VIT/DEF/RES to block hits to 0 (C-PROC-12), and C-DEF-04 + C-STAT-11 guarantee thorns still fire on those BLOCKED hits, unreduced - the whole set loop in one item. THRN 5 = highest live-observed THRN on any item (artifact may push to observed max); DEF/VIT within live shield magnitudes (SHIELD|UNCOMMON DEF max 9, VIT max 4); PDEF 2 under SHIELD|ARTIFACT observed max 4. SHIELD taunt/armor kit copied verbatim from ClassAbilityTemplates - TAUNT synergizes per C-STATUS-12 (collapses enemy targeting onto the taunter, who reflects).

Loc.Name: Tidebinder Sprig
Loc.Description: Driftwood that never dried. Novice tidebinders learn the first law with it: a pinned wave never misses.

Items.DesignNote: Set entry weapon for the focus caster: low-Rolls kit (2-3 slots) means each pinned focus point auto-succeeds a large fraction of the roll (C-STAT-08) and adds +5% crit (C-FOC-04); FOC 1 grows the pool toward the cap (C-STAT-03, max 9). WAND template copied verbatim from ClassAbilityTemplates; WAND_BASIC_ATTACK added exactly as live player wands carry it (WAND_MILITIA_BASIC_00: 0.5/1/INT/2). SKILL_SUPPORTRANGE mirrors live wand passives.

Loc.Name: Tidebinder Circlet
Loc.Description: A band of tide-polished silver that cools the temples. Between battles, the wearer's thoughts pool like slack water.

Items.DesignNote: Focus battery: FOC 2 matches the live ARMOR_HEAD|UNCOMMON curve exactly (observed FOC 2, the HELMET_FOCUS_MAGIC line), pushing the pool toward the 9 cap (C-STAT-03). SKILL_REFOCUS is a verified focus gain source (+1 FOC overworld, C-FOC-05) and appears on this donor's live entry. Every extra point is one more auto-succeeded slot and +5% crit when pinned (C-STAT-08, C-FOC-04).

Loc.Name: Staff of the Scalding Tide
Loc.Description: Cut from a vent-reef where the sea itself boils. It throws breakers of steam and brine, and rewards the caster who spends nothing.

Items.DesignNote: Focus-economy engine: SKILL_HARDWORK refunds the primary action on a 0-focus attack (C-PROC-12), so the Tidebinder banks FOC for the big pinned casts where each point auto-succeeds a slot and adds +5% crit (C-STAT-08, C-FOC-04). STAFF_2H template copied from ClassAbilityTemplates with Stat tuned VIT->INT (live player staffs roll INT, e.g. STAFF_MILITIA_BASIC_00) and live water abilities added (MAGIC_WATER_ATTACK / MAGIC_WATER_SPLASH_ATTACK, both in live Abilities.json); the retained fire kit is the scald in the name. ATK 26 ~ live STAFF_2H|RARE p50 24, EVD 4 at cell minimum.

Loc.Name: Pearl of the Undertow
Loc.Description: A grey pearl that pulls faintly toward the sea. Held tight, it turns patience into precision.

Items.DesignNote: Crit payoff for the focus loop: crits only roll on PERFECT and there is no base crit chance (C-CRIT-01), so CRT 10 plus +5% per pinned focus point (C-FOC-04) makes the Tidebinder's auto-succeeded PERFECTs actually crit. FOC 2 and CRT 10 both sit exactly on the live ARMOR_TRINKET|RARE curve (FOC observed 2, CRT p50 10); HRG 3 at cell minimum for overworld sustain (C-STAT-10).

Loc.Name: Tidebinder's Drowned Moon
Loc.Description: A sphere of seawater that never spills, waxing with its keeper's resolve. Each kill returns the tide to the whole crew.

Items.DesignNote: Set ARTIFACT: SKILL_DISCIPLINE grants party FOC on kill/crit (verified item-passive skill, C-PROC-12; focus gain source per C-FOC-05), turning the set's crit-fishing (C-FOC-04 +5% per point) into a party-wide focus engine - MP-first by construction. MAGIC_FOCUS_ADD_ATTACK_00 (live ORB_WET_LIGHT_00 kit) is a 1-roll CHANGE_STAT FOC action: FOC only lands on PERFECT (C-STAT-07), and a single-roll ability is PERFECT on any success, so one pinned point guarantees it (C-STAT-08). ORB_2H template copied verbatim from ClassAbilityTemplates (incl. bag and ShuffleAbilityBag false); water abilities added exactly as the live donor references them. Stats ATK 18 / FOC 1 / FIND 1 mirror the only live ORB_2H|ARTIFACT cell exactly.

Loc.Name: Gravedigger's Last Spade
Loc.Description: It has closed a thousand graves and opened a few it shouldn't have. Swing it like you mean it, or it will dig your own.

Items.DesignNote: The gambler's weapon: SKILL_HEAVYHANDED gives +20% to rolls but a CRIT_FAIL always breaks the weapon (C-PROC-12; breakage per C-ATK-09) - LCK 5 sweetens every other skill proc since the player proc bonus is (LCK-50)*mult, negative below 50 (C-STAT-15). BLUNT_2H template (BLUNT_GROUND_ATTACK) copied verbatim; BLUNT_BASIC/STUN added exactly as the live donor BLUNT_SHOVEL_HEAVY_00 carries them. ATK 28 / CRT 15 / LCK 5 all on the live BLUNT_2H|RARE curve (p50 28 / min 15 / observed 5).

Loc.Name: Coffin Nail Token
Loc.Description: A bent nail pried from a pauper's coffin and worn smooth by worried thumbs. Wrong to keep; luckier still.

Items.DesignNote: Ladder starter for the LCK stack: below 50 LCK the player skill-proc bonus is NEGATIVE (C-STAT-15), so cheap early LCK is the set's on-ramp; LCK is also the most common overworld TestStat (O-ENC-10/11, 30 of 172 encounters). SKILL_FINDSTUFF is LCK-scaled loot finding (O-STAT-06). LCK 5 / GLD 5 sit at the live ARMOR_TRINKET|COMMON cell maxima.

Loc.Name: Sexton's Quickstep Boots
Loc.Description: Boots that learned to cross a graveyard before dark. Somehow the weather is always kind to whoever wears them.

Items.DesignNote: Overworld mobility payoff: SKILL_NICEDAY adds LCK-scaled golden movement slots (O-STAT-02), and MOV adds movement dice while SPD makes them land (O-STAT-01) - the LCK the set stacks literally becomes map speed. LCK 5 / MOV 1 / SPD 3 all within the live ARMOR_FEET|UNCOMMON cell (LCK max 6, MOV 1, SPD max 8).

Loc.Name: Hangman's Lucky Knot
Loc.Description: A noose that never did its job, cut down and coiled thirteen times. What failed the condemned works wonders for the digger.

Items.DesignNote: The big LCK rock: LCK 20 equals the live ARMOR_TRINKET|RARE maximum (TRINKET_LUCK_00), pushing the wearer past the 50-LCK break-even where skill-proc bonuses turn positive (C-STAT-15) and feeding the most common overworld TestStat (O-ENC-10/11). SKILL_FINDTREASURE is an LCK-scaled find proc (O-STAT-06); LCK does NOT enter loot rarity rolls, so the payoff is procs and encounter checks, not drop tables.

Loc.Name: Crown of the Fortunate Dead
Loc.Description: Buried kings keep no secrets from the one who digs them up. Their pooled fortune settles on the whole party like grave-dust.

Items.DesignNote: Set ARTIFACT: PLCK 10 is a party-wide luck aura (P-prefixed stats apply to every player, C-STAT-04) - the co-op capstone of a set whose proc math is per-character (C-STAT-15). SKILL_FORTUNE is the game's only full-roll re-roll, AWR-scaled (O-ENC-05, C-PROC-12), hence the AWR 5. LCK 10 / PLCK 10 / AWR 5 / GLD 15 all within the live ARMOR_HEAD|ARTIFACT cell (LCK max 7 observed, 10 stays under the p50*1.5 warn line; PLCK/AWR/GLD at observed maxima).
